ai.sum: Zelenskyy discussed security cooperation and rehabilitation of wounded Ukrainian troops with Danish King Frederik X.

europe.title: Energy shock and AI pose fresh challenges for monetary policy, says CBC governor
europe.summary: Central banks must look past headline inflation and examine how energy shocks and artificial intelligence are reshaping economic activity, financing conditions and financial stability, Central Bank of Cyprus governor Christodoulos Patsalides said on Wednesday. He also warned that the combination of geopolitical disruption and rapidly expanding technology investment is creating increasingly complex challenges for policymakers. […]

ai.sum: Central Bank of Cyprus governor Christodoulos Patsalides says energy shocks and AI investment complicate monetary policy.
